chapterInfo.content:
34
Ahyɛdeɛ wɔ Kanaanfoɔ ho
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 2#Eks 23.31 Hyɛ Israelfoɔ no mmara na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ moduru Kanaan asase no so a, (yei ne asase a ɛbɛyɛ mo agyapadeɛ, Kanaan asase no, sɛdeɛ n’ahyeɛ teɛ). 3#Yos 15.1 Mo anafoɔ fam nkyɛn mfiri Sin serɛ so Edom nkyɛn mu. Na mo anafoɔ fam hyeɛ no mfiri Nkyene Po awieeɛ wɔ apueeɛ; 4na mo hyeɛ no mmra Akrabim aforoeɛ anafoɔ fam, na ɛntwam nkɔ Sin, na ɛmfiri hɔ nkɔ Kades-barnea anafoɔ fam, na ɛmfiri hɔ nkɔ Hasar-adar ntwam nkɔfa Asmon. 5Na ɛhyeɛ no nkonton mfiri Asmon nkɔ Misraim subonhwa no mu, na ano nkɔpem po no ano.
6Na atɔeɛ fam hyeɛ no deɛ, ɛpo kɛseɛ a ɛda hɔ ma mo no na ɛnyɛ ɛhyeɛ; ɛno na ɛnyɛ mo atɔeɛ fam hyeɛ.
7Na yei nyɛ mo atifi fam hyeɛ: Momfiri po kɛseɛ no ano mfa mo ani nkari Hor bepɔ, 8na momfiri Hor bepɔ ho nkari deɛ wɔfa kɔ Hamat, na ɛhyeɛ no ano nkɔpem Sedad. 9Na ɛhyeɛ no mfiri hɔ nkɔ Sifron, na ano nkɔpem Hasar-enan; yei na ɛnyɛ mo atifi fam hyeɛ.
10Na monkari apueeɛ fam hyeɛ mfiri Hasar-enan nkɔ Sefam; 11#Luk 5.1 na ɛhyeɛ no mfiri Sefam nsiane nkɔ Ribla, Ain apueeɛ, na ɛhyeɛ no nsiane ara nkɔpem Kineret Po no nsunoa, apueeɛ; 12na ɛhyeɛ no nsiane nkɔduru Yordan, na ano nkɔpem Nkyene Po ano. Yei ne mo asase no, sɛdeɛ ɛho ahyeɛ teɛ.
13Na Mose hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Yei ne asase a momfa ntontobɔ so nkyɛ mu nni soɔ a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma mmusuakuo nkron ne fa no. 14#Num 32.33 Na Ruben mma abusuakuo, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ, ne Gad mma abusuakuo, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ, ne Manase abusuakuo fa no anya wɔn kyɛfa. 15Mmusuakuo mmienu ne fa no anya wɔn kyɛfa Yeriko, Yordan agya, anim fam ne apueeɛ.
16Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 17#Yos 14.1; 21.1; Deut 1.38 Mmarima a wɔnkyɛ asase no mu mma mo no din nie: Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne Nun ba Yosua. 18Na monyiyi mmusuakuo nyinaa mu mmapɔmma mmaako mmaako, na wɔnkyɛ asase no mu. 19#Num 13.6, 30 Mmarima no din nie: Yuda abusuakuo mu: Yefune ba Kaleb; 20Simeon abusuakuo mu: Amihud ba Semuel; 21Benyamin abusuakuo mu: Kislon ba Elidad; 22Dan mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Yogli ba Buki; 23Yosef mma no deɛ: Manase mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Efod ba Haniel; 24Efraim mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Siftan ba Kemuel; 25Sebulon mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Parnak ba Elisafan; 26Isakar mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Asan ba Paltiel; 27Aser mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Selomi ba Ahihud; 28Naftali mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Amihud ba Pedahel. 29Yeinom ne wɔn a AWURADE hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnkyɛ Kanaan asase mma Israelfoɔ no.

Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hyɛ Israelfoɔ no mmara na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ moduru Kanaan asase no so a, (yei ne asase a ɛbɛyɛ mo agyapadeɛ, Kanaan asase no, sɛdeɛ n’ahyeɛ teɛ). Mo anafoɔ fam nkyɛn mfiri Sin serɛ so Edom nkyɛn mu. Na mo anafoɔ fam hyeɛ no mfiri Nkyene Po awieeɛ wɔ apueeɛ; na mo hyeɛ no mmra Akrabim aforoeɛ anafoɔ fam, na ɛntwam nkɔ Sin, na ɛmfiri hɔ nkɔ Kades-barnea anafoɔ fam, na ɛmfiri hɔ nkɔ Hasar-adar ntwam nkɔfa Asmon. Na ɛhyeɛ no nkonton mfiri Asmon nkɔ Misraim subonhwa no mu, na ano nkɔpem po no ano.
Na atɔeɛ fam hyeɛ no deɛ, ɛpo kɛseɛ a ɛda hɔ ma mo no na ɛnyɛ ɛhyeɛ; ɛno na ɛnyɛ mo atɔeɛ fam hyeɛ.
Na yei nyɛ mo atifi fam hyeɛ: Momfiri po kɛseɛ no ano mfa mo ani nkari Hor bepɔ, na momfiri Hor bepɔ ho nkari deɛ wɔfa kɔ Hamat, na ɛhyeɛ no ano nkɔpem Sedad. Na ɛhyeɛ no mfiri hɔ nkɔ Sifron, na ano nkɔpem Hasar-enan; yei na ɛnyɛ mo atifi fam hyeɛ.
Na monkari apueeɛ fam hyeɛ mfiri Hasar-enan nkɔ Sefam; na ɛhyeɛ no mfiri Sefam nsiane nkɔ Ribla, Ain apueeɛ, na ɛhyeɛ no nsiane ara nkɔpem Kineret Po no nsunoa, apueeɛ; na ɛhyeɛ no nsiane nkɔduru Yordan, na ano nkɔpem Nkyene Po ano. Yei ne mo asase no, sɛdeɛ ɛho ahyeɛ teɛ.
Na Mose hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Yei ne asase a momfa ntontobɔ so nkyɛ mu nni soɔ a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma mmusuakuo nkron ne fa no. Na Ruben mma abusuakuo, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ, ne Gad mma abusuakuo, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ, ne Manase abusuakuo fa no anya wɔn kyɛfa. Mmusuakuo mmienu ne fa no anya wɔn kyɛfa Yeriko, Yordan agya, anim fam ne apueeɛ.
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Mmarima a wɔnkyɛ asase no mu mma mo no din nie: Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne Nun ba Yosua. Na monyiyi mmusuakuo nyinaa mu mmapɔmma mmaako mmaako, na wɔnkyɛ asase no mu. Mmarima no din nie: Yuda abusuakuo mu: Yefune ba Kaleb; Simeon abusuakuo mu: Amihud ba Semuel; Benyamin abusuakuo mu: Kislon ba Elidad; Dan mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Yogli ba Buki; Yosef mma no deɛ: Manase mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Efod ba Haniel; Efraim mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Siftan ba Kemuel; Sebulon mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Parnak ba Elisafan; Isakar mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Asan ba Paltiel; Aser mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Selomi ba Ahihud; Naftali mma abusuakuo mu bapɔmma: Amihud ba Pedahel. Yeinom ne wɔn a AWURADE hyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnkyɛ Kanaan asase mma Israelfoɔ no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
